digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and deprecation registry
propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable is superseded by per-class model configuration (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_CRITIC_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_WITNESS_MODEL) and must be deprecated with a migration window via _scheduled registration
when REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set and no per-class model is configured, it must map to all three classes as a fallback default while emitting a deprecation warning
deprecation warnings must be emitted at every environment read site of REBAR_LLM_MODEL (config.py:469 and model_classes.py) to ensure provenance tracking and complete coverage across all code paths
warn_deprecated must be called unconditionally whenever the deprecated variable is consulted, without once-per-process deduplication, with separate warnings for each invocation

six documentation files (README.md, llm-framework.md, config.md, plan-review-gate.md, workflow-authoring-v2.md, env-vars.md) currently present REBAR_LLM_MODEL as the current model-selection interface and must be updated to present per-class configuration instead
operator-visible strings in CLI help text and MCP tool descriptions must be updated to no longer present REBAR_LLM_MODEL as the current model-selection interface
